instructions: Complete the form or the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

groups.context_line: You will hear a father booking a place for his daughter at a summer activity camp.
groups.instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
WILLOWBANK ACTIVITY CAMPS — BOOKING FORM

Child's age when the camp begins: (1) ........
Session booked: the July fortnight
Children are collected each day at: (2) ........
Please leave at home: fizzy drinks and (3) ........
Medical form must be returned by: (4) ........

items.prompt: Child's age when the camp begins: (1) ........
items.evidence: she'll be eleven by the time the camp starts
items.explanation: The father first says his daughter is ten, then remembers her birthday at the end of June and corrects himself: she will be eleven by the time the camp starts.

items.prompt: Children are collected each day at: (2) ........
items.evidence: pick-up is at half past three
items.explanation: When giving the daily times, the staff member says that pick-up is at half past three; only the drop-off time changes.

items.prompt: Please leave at home: fizzy drinks and (3) ........
items.evidence: we ask families not to send mobile phones
items.explanation: The camp asks families not to send mobile phones; the group leaders carry phones, so children can be reached straight away if needed.

items.prompt: Medical form must be returned by: (4) ........
items.evidence: we need it back by the fifth of July
items.explanation: The medical form is the only document to fill in; it will be attached to the confirmation email and must be returned by 5 July at the latest.

groups.context_line: You will hear a woman booking places on a guided cycle ride.
groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
HOLLOWFIELD CYCLE TOURS — THE GREENWAY RIDE

Bikes
- the ride fee already covers a standard hybrid or a road bike
- an electric bike costs an extra £(5) ........ (per bike, for the whole day)

What to bring
- helmets are handed out, but riders need their own water bottle
- the item riders most often forget: a (6) ........

Booking
- the deposit comes back in full if you cancel more than (7) ........ ahead
- the company itself calls the ride off only for (8) ........

items.prompt: an electric bike costs an extra £(5) ........ (per bike, for the whole day)
items.evidence: The electric ones carry a supplement of twelve pounds.
items.explanation: The ride fee covers the hybrid and road bikes; an electric bike carries an extra charge of twelve pounds.

items.prompt: the item riders most often forget: a (6) ........
items.evidence: And the thing people always leave behind is a waterproof jacket.
items.explanation: Helmets are provided by the company and riders bring their own water bottle; the item most often forgotten is a waterproof jacket.

items.prompt: the deposit comes back in full if you cancel more than (7) ........ ahead
items.evidence: If you cancel more than seventy-two hours before, we refund the deposit in full.
items.explanation: If you cancel more than seventy-two hours in advance, the deposit is refunded in full; within that window it is forfeited.

items.prompt: the company itself calls the ride off only for (8) ........
items.evidence: The only thing that stops us is high wind.
items.explanation: The ride goes ahead in the rain; the only thing that stops it is high wind, and the decision is made the evening before.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about how water was moved and stored before modern pumps.
groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
MOVING AND STORING WATER BEFORE MODERN PUMPS

Underground channels
- age of the examples that can be dated with confidence: about (9) ........ years
- water moves by gravity, so what has to be paid for is (10) ........ , not fuel

Stepped wells
- the deepest of them descend as far as (11) ........

Ownership and upkeep
- a household's share was measured in (12) ........ , never in volume

items.prompt: age of the examples that can be dated with confidence: about (9) ........ years
items.evidence: The securely dated examples are closer to three thousand.
items.explanation: The speaker rejects the common claim that they are five thousand years old: the securely dated examples are closer to three thousand years.

items.prompt: water moves by gravity, so what has to be paid for is (10) ........ , not fuel
items.evidence: the running cost of the system is labour rather than energy
items.explanation: Since water moves by gravity, the running cost of the system is labour rather than energy.

items.prompt: the deepest of them descend as far as (11) ........
items.explanation: Some of the stepped wells descend as far as five storeys; the lowest chambers stay cooler than the surface in summer.

items.prompt: a household's share was measured in (12) ........ , never in volume
items.explanation: Because volume could not be measured, shares were defined as time; upkeep obligations were tied to that share too.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about behavioural economics and how findings from it are tested in the field.
groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
BEHAVIOURAL ECONOMICS — SEMINAR NOTES

- changing the wording of a choice changes the choice: this is called (13) ........
- automatic saving scheme: average share of pay saved rose to (14) ........ per cent in four years
- letters about unpaid bills: a reminder sent (15) ........ before the deadline works best

items.prompt: changing the wording of a choice changes the choice: this is called (13) ........
items.evidence: the wording of a choice changes the choice. That's framing.
items.explanation: Because judgements are made relative to a reference point, how a choice is worded changes the choice itself; this effect is called framing.

items.prompt: automatic saving scheme: average share of pay saved rose to (14) ........ per cent in four years
items.evidence: the average saving rate went from about three per cent to eleven per cent over four years
items.explanation: In the automatic saving scheme triggered by a pay rise, the average saving rate rose from about three per cent to eleven per cent over four years.

items.prompt: letters about unpaid bills: a reminder sent (15) ........ before the deadline works best
items.evidence: a reminder that arrives two days before a deadline consistently beats one that arrives two weeks before
items.explanation: A reminder sent two days before the deadline works better than one sent two weeks before.
